WITH per_event AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
  FROM per_event
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT attendance_count
  FROM per_event
  ORDER BY attendance_count DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
SELECT per_event.link_to_event,
       per_event.attendance_count,
       1.0 * per_event.attendance_count / total.total_count
FROM per_event
CROSS JOIN total
CROSS JOIN cutoff
WHERE per_event.attendance_count >= cutoff.attendance_count
ORDER BY 1.0 * per_event.attendance_count / total.total_count DESC
